nodes.label: Kite application icon
nodes.rationale: 128x128 scalable icon: a blue vertical gradient rounded square (26px radius) holding a faceted white/light-blue kite diamond with a white tail triangle. Flat, high-contrast, and legible at dock/favicon sizes.

nodes.label: Faceted kite diamond glyph
nodes.rationale: The diamond is split into four shaded quadrants plus a tail, giving the mark depth with only flat fills so it renders identically at small sizes.
